description.zh: 是否异步校验邮箱。api调用需要为true。否则将同步强校验验证码。通过接口SendAsyncEmailCaptcha发送验证链接。
description.en: Specifies whether to asynchronously verify the email address. Set this parameter to true for API calls. Otherwise, the verification code is synchronously and strictly verified. Call SendAsyncEmailCaptcha to send a verification link.

description.zh: 是否异步校验手机号。api调用需要为true。否则将同步强校验验证码。通过接口SendAsyncMobileCaptcha发送验证链接。
description.en: Specifies whether to asynchronously verify the mobile phone number. Set this parameter to true for API calls. Otherwise, the verification code is synchronously and strictly verified. Call SendAsyncMobileCaptcha to send a verification link.
The email address of the contact.

description.zh: 需要修改的联系人的ID。可调用EnterpriseContactQueryPageList分页查询账号联系人信息。
description.en: The ID of the contact to modify. You can invoke the EnterpriseContactQueryPageList operation to perform a paged query of account contact information.
The mobile phone number of the contact.
The entity ID of the cross-enterprise management object.
The ID of the enterprise to which you have switched.

description.zh: 跨企业管理对象售卖场id
description.en: The sales channel ID of the cross-enterprise management object.

description.zh: 是否公共联系人。当前接口默认set true
description.en: Specifies whether the contact is a public contact. This operation sets this parameter to true by default.

descriptions.zh: 修改企业公共联系人。主账号授权请参考[文档](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/account/user-guide/add-business-address-and-business-contact?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-35469.d_7_0_5.744a1303wP4uCE&scm=20140722.H_2879086._.OR_help-T_cn~zh-V_1)
descriptions.en: Modifies a public enterprise contact. For information about primary account authorization, see [documentation](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/account/user-guide/add-business-address-and-business-contact).
